output.reason_for_conversation: seeking honest prognosis and practical management strategy
output.summary: User living with long covid for six months sought honest information about prognosis and how to manage day-to-day. Bot provided realistic timeline (12-18 months for majority to improve, with no guarantees), explained post-exertional malaise and pacing as the strongest actionable approach, and discussed work accommodations and GP communication strategy. User left with a concrete plan to track activity and approach their GP with specific questions about long covid services and PEM documentation.
